title: TypeScript library operations
description: The public entrypoints of @utv/core: the typed layer's factories and methods, then the JSON layer's exported functions. Every one is a pure in-process call; none changes anything outside the values it returns, so all are queries. Typed factories throw a RangeError for a value that can't exist; partial typed operations return an Outcome; JSON-layer functions return a utv-result/1.0 result and never throw for a semantic outcome.

entities.name: Make a date
entities.description: A proleptic Gregorian date from a year, a 1-based month and a day. CivilDate.tryOf takes the same arguments and returns an Outcome instead of throwing.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilDate; tryOf returns Outcome<CivilDate>.
failures: The day does not exist in that month (30 February, 29 February in a common year): RangeError (day-out-of-range); tryOf gives invalid.
The month is outside 1–12: RangeError (month-out-of-range); tryOf gives invalid.
The year is a number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (field-out-of-range); tryOf gives invalid.

entities.name: Make a year-month
entities.description: A month of a proleptic Gregorian year, without a day. CivilYearMonth.tryOf returns an Outcome instead.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilYearMonth.
failures: The month is outside 1–12: RangeError (month-out-of-range).
The year is a number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (field-out-of-range).

entities.name: Make a time of day
entities.description: A wall-clock time with no date and no zone. It remembers whether a second was given; a nanosecond without a second sets the second to 0. CivilTime.tryOf returns an Outcome instead.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilTime.
failures: Hour, minute, second or nanosecond out of range (hour 24, minute 60): RangeError (field-out-of-range).
Second 60: RangeError (leap-second); tryOf gives unsupported.

entities.name: Make a date-time
entities.description: A wall-clock date and time with no zone. CivilDateTime.tryOf returns an Outcome instead.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilDateTime.
failures: A field out of range: RangeError (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range or field-out-of-range).
Second 60: RangeError (leap-second); tryOf gives unsupported.

entities.name: Add days or weeks to a date
entities.description: Calendar days (addDays) or weeks (addWeeks), carrying across months and years.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: The later or earlier CivilDate.

entities.name: Add months or years to a date
entities.description: Months (addMonths) or years (addYears). Without a policy the day may be missing from the target month; with MonthEnd.Constrain it is clamped to the month's last day.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<CivilDate> without a policy; a plain CivilDate with MonthEnd.Constrain.
failures: The day is missing from the target month (31 January + 1 month): none (month-end).
A policy other than MonthEnd.Constrain passed to the total overload: RangeError.

entities.name: Add a period to a date
entities.description: A calendar Period: years and months first, then the month-end rule, then weeks and days. An optional MonthEnd policy applies.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<CivilDate>.
failures: The day is missing after the months are added: none (month-end), unless MonthEnd.Constrain is passed.
The period has hours, minutes or seconds: invalid (kind-mismatch).

entities.name: Count the days to another date
entities.description: Whole days from this date to the other, negative when the other is earlier.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A number of days.
failures: The count is beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER: an Error is thrown (the JSON layer's daysBetween answers unsupported, implementation-limit).

entities.name: Put a date at a time of day
entities.description: The date and a CivilTime combined into a CivilDateTime, still without a zone.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilDateTime.

entities.name: Add months or years to a year-month
entities.description: Month arithmetic with no day, so it cannot miss a month end.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilYearMonth.

entities.name: Add wall-clock time to a date-time
entities.description: addDays, addWeeks, addHours, addMinutes and addSeconds move the wall clock and carry into days. There is no zone, so there is no DST.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A CivilDateTime.

entities.name: Add months or a period to a date-time
entities.description: addMonths(n) and add(period), with the same month-end rule as dates; addMonths(n, MonthEnd.Constrain) is total.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<CivilDateTime>; a plain CivilDateTime with MonthEnd.Constrain.
failures: The day is missing from the target month: none (month-end).
A policy other than MonthEnd.Constrain passed to the total overload: RangeError.

entities.name: Mean a date-time in a zone
entities.description: The same wall clock as an intention in an IANA zone. Nothing is resolved yet, so no rules are needed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A ZonedIntent.
failures: The text does not look like an IANA zone name: RangeError.

entities.name: Pin a date-time to an offset
entities.description: The same wall clock at a fixed UTC offset, in seconds east of UTC.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A FixedOffsetDateTime.
failures: The offset is beyond ±18:00 or not whole seconds: RangeError (offset-out-of-range).

entities.name: Get the instant of a fixed-offset date-time
entities.description: The one instant a wall clock at a fixed offset names. No rules are needed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Instant.

entities.name: Add wall-clock time to a zoned value
entities.description: addDays, addWeeks, addHours, addMinutes and addSeconds on the wall clock; the zone is kept and an asserted offset is dropped.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A ZonedIntent with no asserted offset.

entities.name: Add months to a zoned value
entities.description: Month arithmetic on the wall clock, with the month-end rule.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<ZonedIntent>; a plain ZonedIntent with MonthEnd.Constrain.
failures: The day is missing from the target month: none (month-end).
A policy other than MonthEnd.Constrain passed to the total overload: RangeError.

entities.name: Resolve a zoned wall time
entities.description: The instant(s) a wall time in a zone names, under the context's rules and an optional gap and overlap policy (strict by default). TemporalContext.resolve(zoned, policy) is the same operation.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<Instant>: unique, or multiple (ascending) in an overlap.
failures: The wall time falls in a gap: none (gap); with Gap.ShiftForward, unique (shifted by the gap).
The wall time happens twice: multiple (ambiguous); Overlap.All gives multiple without the diagnostic; Earliest and Latest give unique.
The zone is not in the rules: unsupported (unknown-zone).
The wall time is within a day of the rules' window edges or outside it: unsupported (outside-rule-window).
An asserted offset is not in force at that wall time: invalid (offset-mismatch).
A policy value the library doesn't know: unsupported (unsupported-policy).

entities.name: Make an instant from Unix seconds
entities.description: Whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z plus optional nanoseconds; Instant.fromUnixNanoseconds takes a bigint count of nanoseconds.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Instant.
failures: An argument is a number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (field-out-of-range).

entities.name: Make an instant from a clock reading
entities.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, as Date.now() or date.getTime() give them. The caller reads the clock; the library never does.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Instant.
failures: A number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (not-an-integer).

entities.name: Make an instant from a Date
entities.description: The instant a Date holds.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Instant.
failures: An Invalid Date: RangeError (invalid-date).

entities.name: Add seconds to an instant
entities.description: PosixSeconds are added exactly; ElapsedSeconds (SI) would need a leap-second table.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Instant for PosixSeconds; Outcome<Instant> for ElapsedSeconds.
failures: ElapsedSeconds: unsupported (needs-leap-seconds).

entities.name: Measure the time to another instant
entities.description: The exact POSIX seconds from this instant to the other.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A PosixSeconds, an exact rational.

entities.name: See an instant at a fixed offset
entities.description: The wall clock at a fixed UTC offset for this instant.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A FixedOffsetDateTime.
failures: The offset is beyond ±18:00: RangeError (offset-out-of-range).
The instant is finer than a nanosecond: RangeError (implementation-limit).

entities.name: See an instant in a zone
entities.description: The wall clock in an IANA zone for this instant, with the offset in force asserted. TemporalContext.inZone(instant, zoneId) is the same operation.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<ZonedIntent>.
failures: The zone is not in the rules: unsupported (unknown-zone).
The instant is outside the rules' window: unsupported (outside-rule-window).
The instant is finer than a nanosecond: unsupported (implementation-limit).

entities.name: Convert an instant to a Date
entities.description: A Date for this instant.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<Date>; unique with a precision-loss warning when sub-millisecond digits were floored.
failures: Beyond the ±8.64e15 ms a Date can hold: unsupported (out-of-native-range).

entities.name: Make a calendar period
entities.description: Years, months, weeks, days and wall-clock hours, minutes and seconds; Period.years(n) … Period.seconds(n) make one-component periods.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A Period. Components may be negative.
failures: A component is a number that is not a safe integer (1.5 days): RangeError (field-out-of-range).

entities.name: Make an amount of POSIX seconds
entities.description: An exact amount numerator/denominator, reduced to lowest terms.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A PosixSeconds.
failures: A zero denominator or a number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (field-out-of-range).

entities.name: Make an amount of SI seconds
entities.description: An exact amount of elapsed SI seconds, as a stopwatch measures them.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An ElapsedSeconds.
failures: A zero denominator or a number that is not a safe integer: RangeError (field-out-of-range).

entities.name: Compare two values of one type
entities.description: compare, isBefore and isAfter on CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime (by instant) and Instant. ZonedIntent has none.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: -1, 0 or 1; true or false for isBefore and isAfter.

entities.name: Make an interval
entities.description: Interval.halfOpen(a, b), Interval.closed(a, b) and Interval.of(start, end) with Bounds: included, excluded, unbounded or unknown. Interval.tryOf returns an Outcome instead.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: An Interval<CivilDate> or Interval<Instant>.
failures: The end is before the start: RangeError (reversed-interval).
Neither end is a point: RangeError (unsupported-form).
The points are of different kinds: RangeError (kind-mismatch).

entities.name: Ask whether an interval contains a point
entities.description: Three-valued membership of a date or an instant.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A Truth: definitely, possibly or impossible.
failures: A point of the other domain (which the type parameter rules out): an Error is thrown.

entities.name: Ask whether two intervals overlap
entities.description: Three-valued overlap of two intervals of the same domain.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A Truth: definitely, possibly or impossible.

entities.name: Parse any text-form value
entities.description: Reads the UTV text form and returns the typed value the text describes.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<UtvValue>.
failures: Text outside the grammar: invalid (syntax), or the field's range code.
Valid notation outside the profile: unsupported (unsupported-form, unsupported-annotation, leap-second or end-of-day).
A valid value with no typed class: unsupported (unsupported-operand).

entities.name: Parse text as one type
entities.description: CivilDate.parse, Instant.parse and the other T.parse methods read the text form and check that it describes a T.
entities.transport: static method of each typed value
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<T>.
failures: The text describes another type (an offset where an Instant is expected): invalid (kind-mismatch).
Anything parse refuses, with the same codes.

entities.name: Read UTV JSON into a typed value
entities.description: fromJson takes a JSON value or its text and returns the typed value it holds.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<UtvValue>.
failures: Text that is not JSON or repeats a key: invalid (malformed-json or duplicate-key).
UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
A valid value no typed class can hold (a zoned date, a floating date-time with a resolutionPolicy, a start-amount interval): unsupported (unsupported-operand).

entities.name: Read UTV JSON as one type
entities.description: CivilDate.fromJson and the other T.fromJson methods check that the JSON holds a T.
entities.transport: static method of each typed value
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<T>.
failures: The JSON holds another kind or form: invalid (kind-mismatch).
Anything fromJson refuses, with the same codes.

entities.name: Write a value as text
entities.description: toString (and String(v)) writes the text form; PosixSeconds and ElapsedSeconds write a display string.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: The text form, or the value's JSON text when the value has no text form.

entities.name: Load zone rules
entities.description: ZoneRules.load(path) reads a rule bundle in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json from a file the caller names; ZoneRules.parse(text) parses one.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A ZoneRules.
failures: The bundle is malformed (not JSON, a missing or mistyped field, transitions out of order): RulesError is thrown.
The file can't be read: the error from node:fs readFileSync is thrown.

entities.name: Hold zone rules in a context
entities.description: A TemporalContext over explicit rules. There is no default context.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A TemporalContext.

entities.name: Order zoned values
entities.description: Resolves zoned values strictly, then compares every pair of candidates.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: Outcome<Ordering>: unique, or multiple with each possible order when an overlap decides it.
failures: Either side's resolution is none, unsupported or invalid: the comparison is that outcome, with both sides' diagnostics (none (gap), unsupported (unknown-zone), …).
Either side falls in an overlap: its ambiguous diagnostic is carried, once per side.

entities.name: Take the one answer of an outcome
entities.description: single() returns the unique value and throws otherwise; uniqueOr(fallback) and toResult() are the other helpers. None of them picks an answer silently.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: The unique value.
failures: The outcome is not unique: OutcomeError, carrying the status and diagnostics.

entities.name: Build canonical UTV JSON
entities.description: date, yearMonth, time, dateTime, inZone, withOffset, instant, period, posixSeconds and interval assemble the canonical everyday shapes. They do not validate: date(2026, 2, 30) is reported invalid by the operations that read it.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A UTV JSON object.

entities.name: Parse ISO 8601 text
entities.description: ISO 8601 extended, RFC 3339 and RFC 9557 forms to a UTV value.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A utv-result/1.0 result with the value as its candidate.
failures: Outside the grammar, or a field out of range: invalid (syntax, month-out-of-range, day-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, offset-out-of-range).
Second 60 or 24:00: unsupported (leap-second, end-of-day).
Week dates, ordinal dates, basic format: unsupported (unsupported-form).
A critical, second or non-zone annotation, or a zone after Z or -00:00: unsupported (unsupported-annotation).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Format ISO 8601 text
entities.description: A civil date, year-month, time or date-time, or a POSIX instant, as ISO 8601 / RFC 9557 text.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is the text.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Another kind, a zoned date or time, an offset with seconds, an instant finer than a nanosecond: unsupported (unsupported-operand or no-text-form).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Parse the text form
entities.description: Points, ISO 8601 periods, bracket intervals and EDTF slash intervals.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is the UTV value.
failures: Everything parseIso refuses, with its codes.
A period with decimal components or an EDTF qualifier: unsupported (unsupported-form).
A reversed interval: invalid (reversed-interval); endpoints of different kinds or forms: invalid (kind-mismatch); an interval with no point: unsupported (unsupported-form).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Format the text form
entities.description: A civil value, instant, calendar period or start-end interval in the text form.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is the text.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
A value the notation can't express (exact seconds, a mixed-sign period, a start-amount or empty interval, any other kind): unsupported (no-text-form).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Get calendar facts
entities.description: Day of week (Monday = 1), day of year, ISO week and week-year, days in month and leap year of a Gregorian date or date-time.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is an object of facts.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
A day that does not exist: invalid (day-out-of-range).
Another kind or form: unsupported (unsupported-operand).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Add an amount
entities.description: A calendar period to a civil value (wall-clock arithmetic, zone kept), or POSIX seconds to an instant, with an optional monthEnd policy.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is the new value; an asserted offset is dropped with an info diagnostic offset-assertion-dropped.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
The day is missing after the months are added and monthEnd is reject: none (month-end).
Time components on a date, anything but years and months on a year-month, a calendar amount on an instant: invalid (kind-mismatch).
SI seconds on a POSIX instant: unsupported (needs-leap-seconds); a time of day or another kind: unsupported (unsupported-operand); an unknown monthEnd: unsupported (unsupported-policy).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Compare two values
entities.description: Civil values of one form, instants, or fixed-offset date-times (by instant).
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is before, equal or after.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Either value is in a named zone: unsupported (needs-zone-rules).
Different kinds or forms, or an unzoned value against a fixed-offset one: unsupported (unsupported-operand).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Count days between dates
entities.description: b − a in days for two Gregorian dates.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is a number of days.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Dates in different zones: unsupported (different-zones).
The count is not a safe integer: unsupported (implementation-limit).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Measure POSIX seconds between instants
entities.description: b − a for two POSIX instants, exactly.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is a posixSeconds amount, reduced.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Another kind or timescale: unsupported (unsupported-operand).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Ask whether an interval contains a point
entities.description: Three-valued membership for civil-date and instant intervals.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is definitely, possibly or impossible.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
A point of the other domain, another construction or domain: unsupported (unsupported-operand); dates in different zones: unsupported (different-zones).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Ask whether intervals overlap
entities.description: Three-valued overlap of two intervals of one domain.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is definitely, possibly or impossible.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Intervals of different domains: unsupported (unsupported-operand).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Resolve a local date-time
entities.description: A civil date-time to instant(s) under explicit rules (a ZoneRules, bundle text or a parsed bundle) and an optional policy.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result with the instant(s) as candidates and the bundle's ruleSet as a manifest dependency.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Not a date-time, or second 60: unsupported (unsupported-operand, leap-second).
No zone: symbolic (no-zone).
Rules that don't parse: invalid (invalid-rules).
The zone is not in the rules: unsupported (unknown-zone); outside the window: unsupported (outside-rule-window).
An asserted offset contradicts the rules: invalid (offset-mismatch).
A gap: none (gap); an overlap: multiple (ambiguous under reject); an unknown policy: unsupported (unsupported-policy).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Convert an instant to a zone
entities.description: The civil date-time in a named zone, with the offset in force as offsetAssertion.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is a zoned civil date-time.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
Rules that don't parse: invalid (invalid-rules).
Unknown zone: unsupported (unknown-zone); outside the window: unsupported (outside-rule-window).
Finer than a nanosecond: unsupported (implementation-limit).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Convert an instant to an offset
entities.description: The civil date-time at a fixed offset. No rules needed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is a fixed-offset civil date-time.
failures: UTV JSON that fails the structural check: invalid with its structural code (duplicate-key, unknown-kind, missing-property, …), or unsupported (unsupported-version) for another well-formed utv/M.N.
The offset is beyond ±18:00 or not whole seconds: invalid (offset-out-of-range).
Finer than a nanosecond: unsupported (implementation-limit).
An unexpected exception inside the operation: status error (internal-error), never a thrown exception.

entities.name: Parse a rule bundle
entities.description: Rule-bundle JSON text, or an already parsed object, to a ZoneRules. Pure: reading the file is the caller's job.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A ZoneRules.
failures: A malformed bundle: RulesError is thrown.

entities.name: Bring a Date in
entities.description: A Date to an instant, a fixed-offset date-time or a zoned date-time, as the caller's intent names.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is the UTV value; with a zone, the bundle's ruleSet is a manifest dependency.
failures: An Invalid Date: invalid (invalid-date).
Intent "local" (or any intent other than the three named ones): unsupported (local-zone).
With a zone or an offset: anything toZone or toOffset refuses, with their codes.

entities.name: Take a Date out
entities.description: An instant or a fixed-offset date-time to a Date.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A NativeResult<Date>: unique, with precision-loss and zone-dropped warnings and loss fields subTick and zone where they apply.
failures: A value in a named zone: unsupported (needs-zone-rules); any other civil value that is not a fixed-offset date-time: unsupported (local-zone).
Beyond ±8.64e15 ms: unsupported (out-of-native-range).
Another kind: unsupported (unsupported-operand).

entities.name: Make an instant from epoch milliseconds
entities.description: A number or bigint of milliseconds since the epoch.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is an instant.
failures: A number that is not a safe integer: invalid (not-an-integer).

entities.name: Take epoch milliseconds out
entities.description: An instant as milliseconds since the epoch, floored.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A NativeResult<number>; information-losing with loss field subTick when digits were floored.
failures: Not a safe integer of milliseconds: unsupported (out-of-native-range).

entities.name: Bring a plain date object in
entities.description: A {year, month, day} object (months 1-based) to a UTV date, checked.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result whose candidate is a civil date.
failures: Fields that aren't integers: invalid (type); a day or month that doesn't exist: invalid (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range), never rolled over.

entities.name: Take a plain date object out
entities.description: An unzoned UTV date to a {year, month, day} object.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A NativeResult<PlainDate>.
failures: Another kind or form, or a zoned date: unsupported (unsupported-operand).
A year beyond a safe integer: unsupported (out-of-native-range).

entities.name: Validate UTV JSON structurally
entities.description: Parses text strictly and checks it against utv/1.0's shapes; validateParsed does the same for an already-parsed value.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A utv-result/1.0 result with status valid, invalid or unsupported.
failures: Malformed JSON or a repeated key: invalid (malformed-json, duplicate-key).
A newer or other well-formed utv/M.N: unsupported (unsupported-version); a malformed identifier: invalid (invalid-schema-identifier).
An unknown kind, a missing or unknown property, a wrong type: invalid (unknown-kind, missing-property, unknown-property, type, one-of, enum).

entities.name: Validate a civil value semantically
entities.description: Runs the structural check, then checks that a proleptic Gregorian civil value names something that exists.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: A result with status valid, invalid or unsupported.
failures: Anything validateStructural refuses, with its result.
A day or month that doesn't exist: invalid (day-out-of-range, month-out-of-range).
Another kind: unsupported (unsupported-operand); another calendar: unsupported (unsupported-calendar).

entities.name: Parse JSON strictly
entities.description: JSON text to a value, rejecting repeated keys.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process library call. Any code that imports @utv/core may call it.
entities.result: The parsed JSON value.
failures: A repeated key: JsonError (duplicate-key) with the JSON pointer of the key.
Malformed text: JsonError (malformed-json).
